what: curriculr: Data-Driven CVs with 'Quarto' and 'Typst' — curriculr-package
title: curriculr: Data-Driven CVs with 'Quarto' and 'Typst' — curriculr-package
text: Provides tools producing data-driven curriculum vitae documents structured data stored Excel workbook. core workflow reads CV content workbook, converts 'Typst' layout blocks, renders polished PDF via 'Quarto' publishing system. Includes functions reading cleaning CV data, building 'Typst' section headings entries, rendering CV sections data frames, scaffolding new CV projects standard folder structure template workbook. Designed separate content layout: CV data lives spreadsheet, rendering configuration lives 'Quarto', transformation logic lives small, reusable R functions. See 'Typst' typesetting system https://typst.app 'Quarto' publishing system https://quarto.org. Inspired 'vitae' package https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=vitae 'Awesome CV' LaTeX template https://github.com/posquit0/Awesome-CV.
